context: Aoi's café, 8am. Kenji walks in for coffee — same morning, different season from the last time. They both notice.
purpose: tiny continuity moment — service warmth across time

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: おはようございます。あ、お久しぶり。
lines.en: Good morning. Oh, it's been a while.
lines.style: Warm recognition in the initial greeting. Genuine pleasure breaking through on the second phrase. Soft, unhurried pace. The warmth of seeing someone familiar.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おはよう。本当に。元気だった？
lines.en: Morning. It really has. How've you been?
lines.style: Gentle warmth in return. A beat of ease in his voice. Natural, conversational pace. The comfort of someone he's happy to see again.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: おかげさまで。今日も、ホット？
lines.en: I've been well, thanks for asking. The usual hot coffee today?
lines.style: Familiar and attentive. Already reading his order before he speaks. Slight lift of care in the rhythm. Small smile audible in the words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、ぜひ。…前と変わらず、いいお店ですね。
lines.en: Yes, please. …You know, this place really hasn't changed. It's still lovely.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity underneath. A genuine compliment, not performance. Soft attack, lingering slightly on the observation. Voice carries a small note of appreciation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 本当にありがとう。…また、来てくださいね。
lines.en: That means so much, thank you. …Please do come back.
lines.style: Genuine warmth in the opening. A small smile audible. The sincerity of someone who means it. Hands over the cup with care in her movement—audible in the pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: もちろん。…ありがとう。今日もいい一日に。
lines.en: I will, definitely. …Thank you. Have a good day.
lines.style: Warm closer with quiet ease. A beat of genuine connection in the goodbye. Voice carries a lightness on the way out, different from the arrival—softer, more at ease.
